headlines.summary: 5월 경상수지 37개월째 흑자 반도체 업황 피크아웃 등 우려 반도체 호황에 지난 5월 경상수지가 역대 최대 폭의 흑자를 기록했다. 8일 한국은행이 발표한 국제수지 잠정치에 따르면 5월 경상수지는 386억1000만 달러(약 58조6000억 원) 흑자로 집계, 직전 최대인 3월(379억3000만 달러)을 두 달 만에 뛰어넘었다.

headlines.title: 정점 vs 저점 … 시험대 오른 ‘반도체주’ [이슈&뷰]
headlines.summary: 반도체 피크아웃 논란 다시 수면위로 ‘저승사자’ 모건스탠리 “주가 조정 온다” WSJ “오징어게임 같아” 변동성 우려 JP모건 “최근 조정, 저가 매수 기회” 국내 증권가 “다시 회복력 보일 것” 구윤철 “리스크 요인 면밀히 점검” 이달말 빅테크 실적·투자계획이 관건 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 등 코스피를 이끄는 반도체주가 진정한 시험대에 올랐다.

headlines.title: 삼전닉스 레버리지 ETF 상장가 붕괴 …‘ 매도 방어 ’ 개미도 역부족
headlines.summary: 변동성 장세 고민 깊어진 투자자들 단일종목 레버리지, 14개 중 13개가 하회 투자자예탁금 한달새 136조→112조 급감 반도체 업황 둘러싼 증권가 전망 엇갈려 한국 증시를 이끌고 있는 반도체 주가가 극심한 변동성을 보이면서 투자자들의 고심이 깊어지고 있다. 8일 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸에서 코스피 지수와 원/달러 환율이 표시돼 있다.

headlines.title: 반도체가 떠받친 경기 회복 … 수출 70%↑에도 제조업·고용은 부진
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 KDI, 경제동향 7월호 발표 AI 수요에 반도체 수출 179.6% 증가…설비투자도 9.7% 확대 서비스업 생산 4.9% 증가했지만 취업자 감소 전환 고용 둔화·고물가 부담 지속…"회복세 제약 가능성" 한국개발연구원(KDI).

headlines.title: “ 너무 비싸 못 먹겠소 ”… 한우도 미국산도 다 올랐다
headlines.summary: 도축물량 감소…한우 안심 1년새 18%↑ ‘환율부담’ 美·호주산도 20%이상 상승 한우 온·오프라인서 최대 50% 할인행사 소고기 가격이 외식 물가를 압박하고 있다. 도축 물량 감소와 고환율 영향으로 가격이 치솟은 가운데 정부의 장바구니 지원 정책에 관심이 쏠린다.

headlines.title: KDI 경기진단 '중동위험' 빼고 " 제조업 생산 조정·서비스 호조"
headlines.summary: "반도체 수출물량 증가세 조정…가격상승세로 수출호조 유지" "국제유가 하락에도 고환율로 물가상승률 둔화는 점진적일 듯" 반도체 공장 후보지 거론 (광주=연합뉴스) 정다움 기자 = 30일 오후 광주 김대중컨벤션센터에서 열린 서남권 첨단산업 발전비전 국민보고회에서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 호남권에 반도체 생산공장(팹)을 만들겠다는 투자 계획을 발표했다.

headlines.title: 6월 서울 아파트, 월세 8247건 > 전세 7108건
headlines.summary: 1년전엔 9586건 < 1만2997건 ‘전세의 월세화’ 현상 뚜렷해져 서울 아파트 임대차 시장에서 월세 거래량이 전세 거래량을 압도하는 ‘전세의 월세화’ 현상이 뚜렷해지고 있다. 불과 1년 전만 해도 전세 거래가 월세 거래에 3500건 가까이 앞섰지만, 올해 6월엔 거래량이 뒤집힌 데 이어 월세 거래가 전세 거래보다 1000건 이상 많았다.

headlines.title: “ 교부금 자동이체 그대로 둘 건가 ”…정부, 교육교부금 개편 논의 본격...
headlines.summary: 기획처 “내국세 자동연동 유지 어려워” 교육부 “소통없이 개편, 성장동력 흔들려” 학령인구 반영한 교부금 개편 원칙 제시 [헤럴드경제=양영경·김용재 기자] 정부가 학령인구 감소와 교육수요 변화에 대응하기 위해 지방교육재정교부금(교육교부금) 개편 논의를 본격화했다.

headlines.title: 석유 최고가격제 손실보전, 경제 잣대로 따져야 [현장에서]
headlines.summary: ■ 현장에서 검찰이 지난 6일 발표한 정유 4사의 유가 담합 의혹 수사 결과가 석유 최고가격제 손실보전 논의와 맞물리면서 정유업계가 술렁이고 있다. 검찰은 정유사들이 최고가격제 아래에서도 제조원가 기준으로 이익을 냈다며 ‘수조 원대 손실’은 과도한 주장이라고 봤다. 싱가포르 국제석유제품가격(MOPS)을 앞세운 손실 산정 논리도 ‘허구’에 가깝다고 봤다.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductors Fuel Economic Recovery, But Manufacturing and Employment Lag
key_headlines.summary: The Korea Development Institute reported semiconductor exports surged 179.6% due to AI demand, yet manufacturing output and employment remain weak despite 70% export growth. Service production increased 4.9%, but job creation has turned negative.

key_headlines.title: Current Account Surplus Boosts Growth Forecast to 3% Range, Rate Hike Expected
key_headlines.summary: With annual current account surplus expected to exceed $25 billion, South Korea's GDP growth forecast was raised to 3% range. High won exchange rates and persistent inflation are concerns, with the central bank likely to raise rates next week.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartments Shift from Jeonse to Monthly Rentals Accelerates
key_headlines.summary: Monthly rental transactions (8,247) now exceed jeonse deposits (7,108) in June, reversing the trend from a year ago when deposits outnumbered rentals by 3,500 units. The shift reflects the growing instability of the traditional jeonse system.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Plunges 5.4% Amid Semiconductor Profit-Taking and Middle East Tensions
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's stock market fell 5.35% to 7,246.79 as cooling semiconductor investment sentiment combined with Middle East geopolitical risks. Foreign investors turned net buyers near market close, while semiconductor stocks face debate over peak valuations.

key_headlines.title: AI Budgets Quadruple as Government Shifts Resources Away from Digital Services
key_headlines.summary: The National Information Society Agency increased AI-related budgets by 314% to 164.4 billion won, while cutting digital government, cloud, and education spending by 68%. This reflects the government's priority shift toward artificial intelligence investment.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing a semiconductor-driven recovery with AI demand pushing chip exports up 179.6% and capital investments expanding 9.7%. However, this growth remains uneven, with service production up 4.9% but employment turning negative and persistent inflation dampening overall momentum. The Korea Development Institute warns recovery could face constraints from employment weakness and high prices. Current account surpluses exceeded $25 billion, raising full-year GDP growth forecasts to 3%, though high won exchange rates present challenges for exports.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea is expected to raise the base rate at next week's monetary policy committee meeting as multiple indicators point toward tightening. Current account surpluses and upward growth revisions are pressuring rates higher, with major investment banks raising 2026 GDP forecasts from 2.8% to 3% in just one month. Inflation remains sticky above the 2% target, and exchange rate volatility at elevated levels is complicating policy decisions. The government is also working on economic stimulus measures while managing concerns over housing affordability and restructuring of struggling mid-sized firms.
sections.Financial Markets: South Korea's stock market experienced a sharp 5.35% decline to 7,246.79, with the KOSDAQ falling 5.6% as semiconductor profit-taking converged with Middle East geopolitical tensions. Foreign investors provided support near market close but broader sentiment remains volatile. Meanwhile, investors are fleeing to safe assets, with bond fund inflows reaching 2.1 trillion won this month alone. The won-dollar exchange rate declined to 1,498.5 won as exporters sold dollars and anticipation built around SK Hynix's Nasdaq listing. Fixed deposit rates at major banks reached the high 3% range, with savings banks offering over 4%, attracting risk-averse investors.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's battery industry faces headwinds as electric vehicle demand softens entering a market chasm phase. LG Energy Solution and GM's joint venture began mass production of LFP battery cells for energy storage systems at a Tennessee facility, meeting US IRA manufacturing requirements and gaining cost competitiveness. Domestically, Korean battery makers are struggling as EV market recovery remains uncertain. Companies are increasingly investing in fire-prevention battery technologies and energy storage solutions as alternatives to overcome current demand weakness.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's rental market is experiencing significant structural shift with monthly rentals (8,247 transactions) now surpassing jeonse deposits (7,108) in June, reversing the pattern from a year prior. This trend reflects deepening instability in the traditional jeonse system and growing housing affordability pressures. Property gifts surged 82% in the first half of 2026 as homeowners seek to avoid capital gains taxes. Nationwide apartment supply expectations improved significantly in July, with hopes tied to regional development projects like the Gwangju semiconductor cluster.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve's June FOMC meeting minutes are attracting significant attention as market participants assess future rate direction under new Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. US inflation remains elevated above the 2% target despite energy price declines, limiting immediate rate cuts. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are weighing on global risk sentiment and equity markets. Trade tensions persist as the Trump administration pursues differentiated policies toward allies, while Walmart's price reductions across key items signal domestic consumer pressures in the United States.
sections.AI & Economy: The National Information Society Agency dramatically increased AI-related budgets by 314% to 164.4 billion won for 2026, reflecting the government's strong pivot toward artificial intelligence development. This expansion came at the expense of digital government, cloud services, and education budgets, which saw 68% cuts. The AI investment surge aligns with broader government plans for 55 trillion won in aerospace and AI sector investments through 2040. Meanwhile, regulatory expansion around AI and other emerging technologies is driving law firm revenues, which surged at an 8.4% annual rate far exceeding overall GDP growth.
sections.Others: The Ministry of Employment and Labor will host a policy forum on September 14 to discuss AI's social impact and corporate profit-sharing mechanisms, following disputes over performance bonuses at Samsung Electronics. Hanwha Group announced additional 500 billion won investment to increase its KAI stake to approximately 15%, reinforcing its defense industry positioning. The government is also pursuing a modest increase in job search incentive allowances from 600,000 to 650,000 won monthly to support youth labor market entry. LG Energy Solution's joint ventures with international partners are expanding production capacity for energy storage solutions in North America.
